name: Qwen-Image-2.1
purpose: Unified model for text-to-image generation and image editing, up to 10 reference images, local edits via masks or annotations, RGBA output.

architecture.why_this_design: Card: mixed-granularity attention and prefix KV cache reuse make it compact and efficient.

pc-16gb.notes: Independent: NF4 peaked at 15.2 GB VRAM on an RTX 5090 (1024px, 40 steps), so 16 GB is tight without offload. No seconds-per-image figure for RDNA3 or RDNA4 (or any AMD card) for this model found in web searches on 2026-11-19.

tona_fit.reason: Top open-weight image quality claim and a small 7B checkpoint that fits every class (about 19 s per image at 8-bit, independent). Compare with z-image-turbo and flux3-image-klein on our own prompts before choosing the default.
